title: Rename a workspace
body:
## Spec

Renaming keeps the workspace's history.

- [ ] 2. Add the rename command
  - [ ] 2.1 Validate the new name
  - with a note that is not a task
- [ ] 2.1 Validate the new name

```markdown
## Acceptance criteria
- AC-9 inside a code block, never read
```

### Acceptance criteria

- The new name shows everywhere at once
  - including the sidebar
- **AC-2** An empty name is refused (REQ-4)
- [AC-5] A name in use is refused

## Out of scope

- [ ] 9. A task outside every recognised section
